rules: Stage 0 and Stage 1 use clean water only, in an unoccupied isolated test cell.
No greywater source is connected until site approval, source risk review, feed characterisation and professional design are admitted.
No chemical challenge recipes, dosing instructions or disinfection settings are specified by this matrix.
Any treatment or intended-use quality decision is owned by independent qualified assessment; the controller cannot self-admit output.
Numerical hydraulic tolerances are frozen only after calibrated instrument uncertainty, reference calculations and test-cell geometry are available.

cases.name: Clean-water normal hydraulic circulation
cases.initial_state: clean water in isolated test rig; treatment bay bypassed to reject, no use outlet
cases.disturbance: normal fill, transfer, tank storage and test-cistern delivery
cases.expected: Stable flow path; no leak; reject and delivery routes distinct
cases.pass_rule: Results within predeclared design envelope and measurement uncertainty; no unexplained route

cases.name: Tank level-to-volume calibration
cases.initial_state: isolated empty tank and calibrated volumetric reference
cases.disturbance: controlled fill and drain across declared operating range
cases.expected: Level channel maps to volume only through versioned geometry/calibration relation
cases.pass_rule: Residuals fit declared uncertainty; no extrapolation outside calibrated range

cases.name: Pump duty and point-of-use service boundary
cases.initial_state: clean-water suction tank; isolated discharge to test cistern
cases.disturbance: declared flow and head points across candidate pump operating envelope
cases.expected: Flow/pressure at actual delivery boundary distinguished from tank inventory and pump nameplate
cases.pass_rule: Measured operating points and uncertainty compared to published pump curve and independent calculation

cases.name: Reject path normal-state verification
cases.initial_state: reuse branch disabled; reject branch enabled
cases.disturbance: source inlet receives clean water with diversion disabled
cases.expected: Water routes only to contained/approved reject path
cases.pass_rule: No liquid reaches the use outlet

cases.name: Independent potable and non-potable boundary inspection
cases.disturbance: qualified cross-connection and backflow hazard review
cases.expected: No shared reservoir/header or unapproved cross-connection; mains backup only through approved arrangement
cases.pass_rule: Written review approval; all points of connection and outlet labels identified

cases.name: Module identity and service replacement
cases.initial_state: module bay empty; one dummy module interface
cases.disturbance: remove/replace module with different serial or revision
cases.expected: Configuration digest changes; prior qualification is revoked; commissioning required
cases.pass_rule: No reuse delivery can be enabled with an unknown or uncommissioned module

cases.name: Unknown or excluded source
cases.disturbance: inject source identity absent or marked excluded
cases.expected: Source isolation and reject; no blending or use credit
cases.pass_rule: No flow reaches treatment/use branch

cases.name: Untreated source residence boundary
cases.initial_state: timestamped untreated volume in isolated raw buffer
cases.disturbance: advance simulation clock to 24 h and beyond 24 h
cases.expected: At/after configured WRC rule boundary, system rejects according to approved timing rule; no overdue untreated source is delivered
cases.pass_rule: No untreated greywater is sent to an end use after 24 h; exact trigger convention frozen with reviewer

cases.name: Missing, stale or unadmitted quality evidence
cases.disturbance: remove, stale-date or revoke required sample/result/channel evidence
cases.expected: Quality disposition Indeterminate; delivery remains isolated; diversion to reject
cases.pass_rule: No use-volume credit and no delivery to use outlet

cases.name: Wrong intended-use profile
cases.initial_state: quality assessment bound to a different use profile
cases.disturbance: request toilet-flush credit under mismatched profile
cases.expected: Not comparable / not creditable; route remains isolated
cases.pass_rule: No cross-use credit

cases.name: Disinfection barrier unproven
cases.disturbance: seed loss of process-validity evidence or failed independent outlet sample
cases.expected: Reuse outlet closed; source to reject; municipal cistern fallback remains separate
cases.pass_rule: No output is admitted for toilet flushing

cases.name: Stale or invalid critical sensor
cases.disturbance: freeze source flow, level, pressure or time channel; mark stale/invalid
cases.expected: Affected claim becomes Indeterminate; fail-safe diversion/stop according to hazard mapping
cases.pass_rule: No stale sensor value is silently reused as current

cases.name: Loss of electrical power
cases.initial_state: clean water in test rig; reviewed passive reject path
cases.disturbance: remove primary power
cases.expected: Reuse delivery stops; incoming flow reaches safe reject if hydraulically possible; cistern backup is independent
cases.pass_rule: No unqualified or uncontrolled discharge to a use point

cases.name: Raw tank high-high and overflow
cases.disturbance: seed high-high level or block normal transfer
cases.expected: Stop capture or divert before uncontrolled overflow; overflow separately metered/contained
cases.pass_rule: No overflow enters stormwater or an unapproved drain

cases.name: Pump no-flow / low-pressure failure
cases.disturbance: pump disabled or pressure/flow below declared service envelope
cases.expected: Reuse pump isolated; no service credited; independent cistern fallback available
cases.pass_rule: No false service delivery reported

cases.name: Blocked screen or filter
cases.disturbance: seed blockage / differential pressure outside reviewed envelope
cases.expected: Module isolated or maintenance alarm, feed diverted; no uncontrolled bypass to use
cases.pass_rule: Fail-safe action and safe maintenance isolation verified

cases.name: Leak and containment
cases.initial_state: dry containment and leak sensor verified
cases.disturbance: controlled clean-water leak challenge at reviewed test point
cases.expected: Containment detects or independently measures loss; no electrical hazard or uncontrolled floor discharge
cases.pass_rule: Leak remains contained; loss is not hidden in a forced balance

cases.name: Suspected potable/non-potable cross-connection
cases.disturbance: design/inspection challenge identifies a physical or potential connection
cases.expected: System quarantined; no commissioning or use until qualified remediation and approval
cases.pass_rule: Zero unresolved cross-connections

cases.name: Module revision or material mismatch
cases.disturbance: substitute unknown material, seal, component or firmware revision
cases.expected: Configuration mismatch, qualification invalidated, isolation maintained
cases.pass_rule: No automatic inheritance of prior module qualification

cases.name: Water balance residual exceeds uncertainty
cases.disturbance: inject an unmetered leak or perturb a channel
cases.expected: Residual reported as unresolved; evaluator does not force closure or assign zero
cases.pass_rule: Balance status Indeterminate/Fail outside declared uncertainty; no omitted sink added
